ns2:course.label: Contracts
ns2:course.description: Enforceability of promises including unjust enrichment and reliance, offer and acceptance, mistake, unfairness and overreaching, unconscionability, Statute of Frauds, interpretation of contract language, conditions, and third party beneficiaries. 4 graduate hours. 4 professional hours.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Law department.
